```{r}
fig_cap_exceedance <- sprintf(
  "Marginal predicted probability of poor sleep quality (Fairly bad or Very bad) as a function of late-night gaming. Predictions are derived from the H1a probit cumulative link mixed model fitted separately on each of %d multiply imputed datasets; predicted probabilities and their within-imputation variances are then pooled via Rubin's rules. The solid line shows the pooled point estimate and the shaded ribbon the 95%% confidence interval, both computed on the probability scale using the delta method applied to each imputation's threshold, gaming coefficient, and variance--covariance matrix, then combined with Rubin's within- and between-imputation variance components. Probabilities are population-average (marginalised over the participant random intercept) with other covariates held at their reference or mean values. The top panel shows the marginal density of late-night gaming in the sample; vertical reference lines mark the median, mean, 75th, and 90th percentiles.",
  n_imputations_panel
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-latenight-sleepquality-exceedance
#| fig-cap: !expr fig_cap_exceedance
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
#| code-summary: "Probability of poor sleep quality by late-night gaming"

library(ordinal)
library(patchwork)

# Load the Rubin bundle for H1a (or fall back to cached)
panel_h1a_fig_bundle <- if (!is.null(panel_h1a_bundle)) panel_h1a_bundle else
  tryCatch(readRDS("output/models/imputed_h1a_rubin.rds"), error = function(e) NULL)

fits <- panel_h1a_fig_bundle$fits
m    <- length(fits)

# Prediction grid: 0–90 min in 10-min units
ln_sequence_10 <- seq(0, 9, by = 0.1)
ln_bins <- c(0, 30, 60, 90)

# Distribution statistics for reference lines
ln_stats <- gamingMonthly |>
  filter(!is.na(ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played)) |>
  pull(ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played) |>
  {\(x) list(
    mean = mean(x),
    median = median(x),
    p75 = quantile(x, 0.75),
    p90 = quantile(x, 0.90)
  )}()

# --- Per-imputation marginal predictions with delta-method variance ----------
# For each of the 20 imputed fits, compute:
#   P(Y > "Fairly good" | x) = 1 - Phi(g(x) / denom)
# where g(x) = alpha_j - b*x, denom = sqrt(1 + sigma_u^2)
# and Var(prob) via delta method using that fit's vcov.
pred_list <- lapply(seq_len(m), function(i) {
  f <- fits[[i]]

  alpha_j  <- f$alpha["Fairly good|Fairly bad"]
  b_gaming <- coef(f)["ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10"]
  sigma_u  <- f$ST$pid[1, 1]
  denom    <- sqrt(1 + sigma_u^2)

  V <- as.matrix(vcov(f))
  var_alpha <- V["Fairly good|Fairly bad", "Fairly good|Fairly bad"]
  var_b     <- V["ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10",
                  "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10"]
  cov_ab    <- V["Fairly good|Fairly bad",
                  "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10"]

  g_x    <- alpha_j - b_gaming * ln_sequence_10
  prob   <- pnorm(g_x / denom, lower.tail = FALSE)

  # Within-imputation variance on probability scale (delta method)
  var_gx   <- var_alpha + ln_sequence_10^2 * var_b - 2 * ln_sequence_10 * cov_ab
  dphi     <- dnorm(g_x / denom) / denom
  var_prob <- dphi^2 * var_gx

  tibble(x = ln_sequence_10, prob = prob, var_prob = var_prob)
})

# --- Pool predictions via Rubin's rules --------------------------------------
prob_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(pred_list, \(d) d$prob))
var_mat  <- do.call(cbind, lapply(pred_list, \(d) d$var_prob))

qbar      <- rowMeans(prob_mat)                    # pooled point estimate
ubar      <- rowMeans(var_mat)                     # mean within-imputation var
b_var     <- apply(prob_mat, 1, var)               # between-imputation var
total_var <- ubar + (1 + 1/m) * b_var              # Rubin's total variance
se_pooled <- sqrt(total_var)

plot_data <- tibble(
  ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played = ln_sequence_10 * 10,
  exc.prob  = qbar,
  asymp.LCL = qbar - 1.96 * se_pooled,
  asymp.UCL = qbar + 1.96 * se_pooled
)

# Prepare raw data for marginal distribution
marginal_data <- gamingMonthly |>
  filter(!is.na(ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played)) |>
  select(ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played)

# Create distribution panel (top)
p_dist <- ggplot(marginal_data, aes(x = ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played)) +
  geom_density(fill = "gray70", color = "gray50", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ln_stats$median, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ln_stats$mean, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ln_stats$p75, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ln_stats$p90, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = ln_bins,
    labels = paste0(ln_bins, " min"),
    limits = c(0, 90)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Density", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5)
  )

# Create main prediction plot
p_main <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played, y = exc.prob)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ln_stats$median, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ln_stats$mean, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ln_stats$p75, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ln_stats$p90, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = ln_stats$median, y = max(plot_data$asymp.UCL),
           label = "Median", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray40") +
  annotate("text", x = ln_stats$mean, y = max(plot_data$asymp.UCL),
           label = "Mean", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray40") +
  annotate("text", x = ln_stats$p75, y = max(plot_data$asymp.UCL),
           label = "75th %ile", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray40") +
  annotate("text", x = ln_stats$p90, y = max(plot_data$asymp.UCL),
           label = "90th %ile", angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "gray40") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL),
              alpha = 0.3, fill = "#d62828") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "#d62828") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = ln_bins,
    labels = paste0(ln_bins, " min"),
    limits = c(0, 90)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "Average Daily Late-Night Gaming (min/day)",
    y = "Predicted Probability of Poor Sleep Quality"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# Combine plots using patchwork
(p_dist / p_main) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 3)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Probability of Poor Sleep Quality by Late-Night Gaming"
  )
```

To complement these pooled coefficient tests with positive evidence of null effects where applicable, we conducted frequentist equivalence tests (TOST; @lakens2017equivalence) on the focal H1 predictors against  an interval around zero within which a coefficient is treated as too small to matter substantively (ROPE), derived from ±0.1 × SD(outcome) rescaled to the raw coefficient's native units (see @sec-appendix-equivalence for full derivation and response-scale thresholds). The pooled 90% CIs for H1b, H1c, and H1d all fall entirely within their respective ROPEs, providing positive evidence that any direct effect of late-night gaming on sleep duration, daytime sleepiness, and wellbeing is practically negligible at this benchmark. We note that the ROPE width itself was not preregistered: we adopt Kruschke's [-@kruschke2018rejecting] rule-of-thumb ±0.1 × SD(*y*) (rescaled to native units) as a conventional anchor for what counts as a negligible effect, and the natural-unit translation in the Discussion provides the substantive interpretation. The H1a sleep-quality effect, although statistically non-zero, was undecided under the stricter ordinal-probit ROPE: the 90% CI lies partly outside the interval, so the estimate cannot be declared either practically equivalent to or reliably larger than zero. Full per-hypothesis TOST decisions, ROPE widths, and pooled 90% CIs are reported in @tbl-appendix-equivalence.

### H2

The Stage 1 protocol [@ballou2024psychological] further specified four moderation models that added a late-night gaming × chronotype (MSF~sc~) interaction to the H1 specifications, predicting the same four outcomes (H2a–H2d); chronotype had a median of `r sprintf("%.1f", stats::median(master_data$msf_sc, na.rm = TRUE))` hours (IQR `r sprintf("%.1f", stats::IQR(master_data$msf_sc, na.rm = TRUE))`) in the analytical sample. In Open Play this structure proved even more demanding than H1, so we mean-centred chronotype and applied the same random-effects simplification used in H1 (random intercepts for participants, and for gender where supported, dropping the by-participant random slopes on late-night minutes) while retaining the gaming × chronotype interaction for all four outcomes. With these adjustments, the ordinal H2a CLMM converged cleanly alongside the H2b–H2d linear mixed-effects models, with finite standard errors for all fixed effects (including the interaction term) in both the complete-case and imputed fits. Full main, interaction, and random-effect estimates are reported in the H2 regression summary table.

```{r}
#| label: h2-main-effects
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Load Rubin bundles for H2 inline effects
panel_h2a_bundle <- if (length(panel_h2_rubin)) panel_h2_rubin[["H2a: Sleep Quality"]] else
  tryCatch(readRDS("output/models/imputed_h2a_rubin.rds"), error = function(e) NULL)
panel_h2b_bundle <- if (length(panel_h2_rubin)) panel_h2_rubin[["H2b: Sleep Duration"]] else
  tryCatch(readRDS("output/models/imputed_h2b_rubin.rds"), error = function(e) NULL)
panel_h2c_bundle <- if (length(panel_h2_rubin)) panel_h2_rubin[["H2c: Daytime Sleepiness"]] else
  tryCatch(readRDS("output/models/imputed_h2c_rubin.rds"), error = function(e) NULL)
panel_h2d_bundle <- if (length(panel_h2_rubin)) panel_h2_rubin[["H2d: Wellbeing"]] else
  tryCatch(readRDS("output/models/imputed_h2d_rubin.rds"), error = function(e) NULL)

# Interaction effects (primary H2 tests). Formatted via get_pooled_effect,
# which now uses %.3f precision (helpers.R) so small probit coefficients
# don't silently render as -0.00.
h2a_ln_minutes_msf <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2a_bundle,
  "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10:msf_sc_centered")
h2b_ln_minutes_msf <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2b_bundle,
  "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10:msf_sc_centered")
h2d_ln_minutes_msf <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2d_bundle,
  "ln_biweekly_avg_minutes_played_10:msf_sc_centered")
h2c_ln_minutes_msf <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2c_bundle,
  "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10:msf_sc_centered")

# (Exploratory) main effects for late-night gaming and chronotype
h2a_main_ln <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2a_bundle, "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10")
h2a_main_msf <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2a_bundle, "msf_sc_centered")

h2b_main_ln <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2b_bundle, "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10")
h2b_main_msf <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2b_bundle, "msf_sc_centered")

h2d_main_ln <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2d_bundle, "ln_biweekly_avg_minutes_played_10")
h2d_main_msf <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2d_bundle, "msf_sc_centered")

h2c_main_ln <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2c_bundle, "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10")
h2c_main_msf <- get_pooled_effect(panel_h2c_bundle, "msf_sc_centered")

# Marginal probability computation for H2a (probit CLMM) — pooled estimates
h2a_marginal <- tryCatch({
  pv <- pool_vcov(panel_h2a_bundle$fits)
  b_ln <- pv$qbar["ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10"]
  alpha_j <- average_re_quantity(panel_h2a_bundle$fits, function(f)
    f$alpha["Fairly good|Fairly bad"])
  sigma_u <- average_re_quantity(panel_h2a_bundle$fits, function(f)
    f$ST$pid[1, 1])
  marginal_sd <- sqrt(1 + sigma_u^2)
  pp_per_10min <- dnorm((b_ln * 0 - alpha_j) / marginal_sd) *
    b_ln / marginal_sd * 100
  list(pp_per_10min = pp_per_10min)
}, error = function(e) NULL)
```

From these models, the main effect of late-night gaming on sleep quality in H2a is `r h2a_main_ln` (probit coefficient per 10 min/day), corresponding to an approximate `r fmt_pp(h2a_marginal)` percentage-point increase in the probability of reporting fairly bad or worse sleep per additional 10 minutes of daily late-night gaming, closely mirroring the H1a estimate. None of the preregistered chronotype × late-night gaming interactions reached conventional significance after pooling across imputations, so H2 was not supported for any outcome (H2a sleep quality: `r h2a_ln_minutes_msf` probit per 10 min/day per hour of MSFsc; H2b sleep duration: `r h2b_ln_minutes_msf` hours per 10 min/day per hour of MSFsc; H2c daytime sleepiness: `r h2c_ln_minutes_msf` Epworth points per 10 min/day per hour of MSFsc; H2d wellbeing: `r h2d_ln_minutes_msf` SWEMWBS points per 10 min/day per hour of MSFsc). The equivalence tests reported in @tbl-appendix-equivalence go further and provide positive evidence that these interactions are practically negligible: applying the same earlier TOST procedure now to the chronotype × late-night gaming coefficients against their interaction-scale ROPEs the pooled 90% CIs for H2b, H2c, and H2d all lie entirely within the ROPE, while the H2a interaction is undecided under the stricter ordinal-probit ROPE. Full model summaries are reported in @tbl-h2-combined.

```{r}
#| label: fit-h2-models
#| code-summary: "Fit H2 models for both outcome versions"
#| cache: false
#| results: asis

# runtime: ~seconds when params$refit_h2 is false (bundles read from disk).
#          Expected ~3-6 min per imputed model when refit_h2=true (20
#          imputations × 4 models with chronotype interaction). Set
#          -P refit_h2:true to regenerate.
h2_models <- list()
panel_h2_rubin <- list()  # Rubin's rules bundles for imputed H2 models

# --- Shared prep functions for H2 ---
panel_h2_prep_monthly_clmm <- function(d) {
  inputs <- build_gaming_inputs(d)
  inputs$gamingMonthly |>
    enforce_monthly_wave_subset() |>
    mutate(
      psqi_comp1_quality_rounded = round(psqi_comp1_quality),
      psqi_6_ord = factor(
        psqi_comp1_quality_rounded,
        levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3),
        labels = c("Very good", "Fairly good", "Fairly bad", "Very bad"),
        ordered = TRUE
      )
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(psqi_6_ord), !is.na(msf_sc_centered))
}

panel_h2_prep_monthly_lmer <- function(d) {
  inputs <- build_gaming_inputs(d)
  inputs$gamingMonthly |>
    enforce_monthly_wave_subset() |>
    filter(!is.na(msf_sc_centered), !is.na(total_hours_sleep), !is.na(epsTotal))
}

panel_h2_prep_biweekly <- function(d) {
  inputs <- build_gaming_inputs(d)
  inputs$gamingBiweekly |>
    filter(!is.na(msf_sc_centered), !is.na(wemwbs))
}

# --- Complete-case fitting (single fit, unchanged) ---
fit_panel_h2_completecase <- function(inputs, version_label) {
  gamingMonthly <- inputs$gamingMonthly |> enforce_monthly_wave_subset()
  gamingBiweekly <- inputs$gamingBiweekly

  gamingMonthly_complete <- gamingMonthly |>
    filter(!is.na(msf_sc_centered), !is.na(total_hours_sleep), !is.na(epsTotal))
  gamingBiweekly_complete <- gamingBiweekly |>
    filter(!is.na(msf_sc_centered), !is.na(wemwbs))

  if (nrow(gamingMonthly_complete) < 50 || nrow(gamingBiweekly_complete) < 50) {
    message(sprintf("Skipping H2 completecase: insufficient cases (monthly: %d, biweekly: %d)",
                    nrow(gamingMonthly_complete), nrow(gamingBiweekly_complete)))
    return(NULL)
  }

  gamingMonthly_h2 <- gamingMonthly |>
    mutate(
      psqi_comp1_quality_rounded = round(psqi_comp1_quality),
      psqi_6_ord = factor(
        psqi_comp1_quality_rounded,
        levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3),
        labels = c("Very good", "Fairly good", "Fairly bad", "Very bad"),
        ordered = TRUE
      )
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(psqi_6_ord), !is.na(msf_sc_centered))

  model.h2a <- clmm(
    psqi_6_ord ~ ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10 * msf_sc_centered +
      age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend +
      (1 | pid),
    data = gamingMonthly_h2,
    link = "probit", Hess = TRUE,
    control = clmm.control(maxIter = 5000, gradTol = 1e-3)
  )

  model.h2b <- lmer(
    total_hours_sleep ~ ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10 * msf_sc_centered +
      age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend +
      (1 | pid) + (1 | gender),
    data = gamingMonthly_complete
  )

  model.h2c <- lmer(
    epsTotal ~ ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10 * msf_sc_centered +
      age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend +
      (1 | pid) + (1 | gender),
    data = gamingMonthly_complete
  )

  model.h2d <- lmer(
    wemwbs ~ ln_biweekly_avg_minutes_played_10 * msf_sc_centered +
      age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend +
      (1 | pid) + (1 | gender),
    data = gamingBiweekly_complete
  )

  saveRDS(model.h2a, glue("output/models/{version_label}_model_h2a.rds"))
  saveRDS(model.h2b, glue("output/models/{version_label}_model_h2b.rds"))
  saveRDS(model.h2c, glue("output/models/{version_label}_model_h2c.rds"))
  saveRDS(model.h2d, glue("output/models/{version_label}_model_h2d.rds"))

  list(
    `H2a: Sleep Quality` = model.h2a,
    `H2b: Sleep Duration` = model.h2b,
    `H2c: Daytime Sleepiness` = model.h2c,
    `H2d: Wellbeing` = model.h2d
  )
}

if (eval_panel) {
  # --- Imputed: Rubin's rules ---
  message("Fitting H2 models on 20 imputed datasets (Rubin's rules)...")

  panel_h2_rubin[["H2a: Sleep Quality"]] <- fit_on_imputations(
    imputed_long,
    prep_fn = panel_h2_prep_monthly_clmm,
    fit_fn = function(d) clmm(
      psqi_6_ord ~ ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10 * msf_sc_centered +
        age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend +
        (1 | pid),
      data = d, link = "probit", Hess = TRUE,
      control = clmm.control(maxIter = 5000, gradTol = 1e-3)
    )
  )

  panel_h2_rubin[["H2b: Sleep Duration"]] <- fit_on_imputations(
    imputed_long,
    prep_fn = panel_h2_prep_monthly_lmer,
    fit_fn = function(d) lmer(
      total_hours_sleep ~ ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10 * msf_sc_centered +
        age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend +
        (1 | pid) + (1 | gender),
      data = d
    )
  )

  panel_h2_rubin[["H2c: Daytime Sleepiness"]] <- fit_on_imputations(
    imputed_long,
    prep_fn = panel_h2_prep_monthly_lmer,
    fit_fn = function(d) lmer(
      epsTotal ~ ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10 * msf_sc_centered +
        age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend +
        (1 | pid) + (1 | gender),
      data = d
    )
  )

  panel_h2_rubin[["H2d: Wellbeing"]] <- fit_on_imputations(
    imputed_long,
    prep_fn = panel_h2_prep_biweekly,
    fit_fn = function(d) lmer(
      wemwbs ~ ln_biweekly_avg_minutes_played_10 * msf_sc_centered +
        age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend +
        (1 | pid) + (1 | gender),
      data = d
    )
  )

  for (nm in names(panel_h2_rubin)) {
    tag <- switch(nm,
      "H2a: Sleep Quality" = "h2a",
      "H2b: Sleep Duration" = "h2b",
      "H2c: Daytime Sleepiness" = "h2c",
      "H2d: Wellbeing" = "h2d"
    )
    saveRDS(panel_h2_rubin[[nm]], glue("output/models/imputed_{tag}_rubin.rds"))
  }

  h2_models[["imputed"]] <- lapply(panel_h2_rubin, `[[`, "pooled")

} else {
  # Load cached models
  rubin_paths_h2 <- list(
    "H2a: Sleep Quality" = "output/models/imputed_h2a_rubin.rds",
    "H2b: Sleep Duration" = "output/models/imputed_h2b_rubin.rds",
    "H2c: Daytime Sleepiness" = "output/models/imputed_h2c_rubin.rds",
    "H2d: Wellbeing" = "output/models/imputed_h2d_rubin.rds"
  )
  if (all(file.exists(unlist(rubin_paths_h2)))) {
    panel_h2_rubin <- lapply(rubin_paths_h2, readRDS)
    h2_models[["imputed"]] <- lapply(panel_h2_rubin, `[[`, "pooled")
  } else {
    cached <- load_h2_models_from_disk("imputed")
    if (!is.null(cached)) h2_models[["imputed"]] <- cached
  }
}

# --- Complete-case H2 (appendix) ---
if (eval_appendix) {
  cc_fitted <- fit_panel_h2_completecase(gaming_inputs[["completecase"]], "completecase")
  if (!is.null(cc_fitted)) h2_models[["completecase"]] <- cc_fitted
} else {
  cached_cc <- load_h2_models_from_disk("completecase")
  if (!is.null(cached_cc)) h2_models[["completecase"]] <- cached_cc
}

```

## Diary

### H1 and H2

```{r}
#| label: diary-data-prep
#| cache: true
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Load raw diary data
diary_survey_raw <- read_csv(
  "data/raw/survey_daily.csv.gz",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

diary_timeuse_raw <- read_csv(
  "data/raw/timeuse.csv.gz",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

diary_gaming_sessions_raw <- read_csv(
  "data/processed/gaming_sessions.csv.gz",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# --- Enforce ≥10h gap between consecutive diary entries per participant ---
diary_survey <- diary_survey_raw |>
  mutate(
    diary_ts = ymd_hms(date, tz = "UTC"),
    diary_day = as_date(diary_ts),
    wave_id = as.integer(wave),
    sleep_quality_num = recode_sleep_quality(sleep_diary_quality)
  ) |>
  arrange(pid, diary_ts) |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  mutate(
    gap_hours = as.numeric(difftime(diary_ts, lag(diary_ts), units = "hours")),
    keep_entry = is.na(gap_hours) | gap_hours >= 10
  ) |>
  filter(keep_entry) |>
  ungroup()

# --- Derive sleep metrics from time-use diaries ---
diary_timeuse <- diary_timeuse_raw |>
  filter(quality_flag == "Good quality") |>
  mutate(
    diary_day = ymd(date),
    wave_id = as.integer(daily_wave),
    start_ts = ymd_hms(start_time, tz = "UTC"),
    end_ts = ymd_hms(end_time, tz = "UTC")
  ) |>
  arrange(pid, wave_id, start_ts) |>
  group_by(pid, wave_id) |>
  mutate(activity_run = cumsum(activity != lag(activity, default = first(activity)))) |>
  group_by(pid, wave_id, activity_run, activity) |>
  summarise(
    diary_day = min(diary_day, na.rm = TRUE),
    start_ts = min(start_ts, na.rm = TRUE),
    end_ts = max(end_ts, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    start_minutes = hour(start_ts) * 60 + minute(start_ts) + second(start_ts) / 60,
    end_minutes = hour(end_ts) * 60 + minute(end_ts) + second(end_ts) / 60,
    duration_minutes_raw = end_minutes - start_minutes,
    duration_minutes = case_when(
      is.na(start_minutes) | is.na(end_minutes) ~ NA_real_,
      duration_minutes_raw < 0 ~ duration_minutes_raw + 24 * 60,
      TRUE ~ duration_minutes_raw
    ),
    duration_hours = duration_minutes / 60
  )

diary_sleep_summary <- diary_timeuse |>
  filter(activity == "Sleep") |>
  arrange(pid, wave_id, start_ts) |>
  group_by(pid, wave_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_sleep_segments = n(),
    sleep_duration_hours = sum(duration_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    bedtime_utc = max(start_ts, na.rm = TRUE),
    wakeup_utc = first(end_ts),
    diary_day = min(diary_day, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_sleep_segments = if_else(n_sleep_segments > 10, NA_integer_, n_sleep_segments),
    sleep_duration_hours = if_else(n_sleep_segments > 10, NA_real_, sleep_duration_hours),
    bedtime_utc = if_else(n_sleep_segments > 10, as.POSIXct(NA), bedtime_utc),
    wakeup_utc = if_else(n_sleep_segments > 10, as.POSIXct(NA), wakeup_utc)
  )

# Remove sleep duration outliers beyond 3 SD
diary_sleep_stats <- diary_sleep_summary |>
  summarise(mu = mean(sleep_duration_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
            sigma = sd(sleep_duration_hours, na.rm = TRUE))
if (!is.na(diary_sleep_stats$sigma) && diary_sleep_stats$sigma > 0) {
  diary_sleep_summary <- diary_sleep_summary |>
    mutate(sleep_duration_hours = if_else(
      abs(sleep_duration_hours - diary_sleep_stats$mu) > 3 * diary_sleep_stats$sigma,
      NA_real_, sleep_duration_hours
    ))
}

# --- Late-night gaming in prior 24h ---
diary_gaming_sessions <- diary_gaming_sessions_raw |>
  mutate(
    session_start = ymd_hms(sessionStart, tz = "UTC", quiet = TRUE),
    session_end = ymd_hms(sessionEnd, tz = "UTC", quiet = TRUE),
    latenightMinutes = replace_na(latenightMinutes, 0)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(session_start), !is.na(session_end), session_end > session_start)

diary_late_night <- diary_survey |>
  select(pid, wave_id, diary_ts) |>
  left_join(diary_gaming_sessions, by = "pid") |>
  filter(
    session_end > diary_ts - hours(24),
    session_start <= diary_ts
  ) |>
  mutate(
    overlap_minutes = pmax(0, as.numeric(difftime(
      pmin(session_end, diary_ts),
      pmax(session_start, diary_ts - hours(24)),
      units = "mins"
    ))),
    session_minutes = as.numeric(difftime(session_end, session_start, units = "mins")),
    overlap_frac = if_else(session_minutes > 0, overlap_minutes / session_minutes, 0),
    late_night_minutes_overlap = latenightMinutes * overlap_frac
  ) |>
  group_by(pid, wave_id) |>
  summarise(
    late_night_gaming_hours_24h = sum(late_night_minutes_overlap, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- Chronotype lookup from wave 1 self-report (reuse already-loaded data) ---
diary_chronotype_lookup <- selfreport_imputed |>
  filter(wave == 1) |>
  distinct(pid, msf_sc_numeric, msf_sc_centered, mctq_fd_alarm_clock_used) |>
  mutate(
    chronotype_hours = msf_sc_numeric,
    chronotype_centered = msf_sc_centered,
    no_alarm_free = mctq_fd_alarm_clock_used == "No"
  ) |>
  select(pid, chronotype_hours, chronotype_centered, no_alarm_free)

# --- Covariate lookup from intake data (reuse already-loaded data) ---
diary_covariate_lookup <- data.intake |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    pid,
    region = factor(country),
    gender = factor(na_if(gender, "NA")),
    age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(age)),
    height_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(height)),
    weight_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(weight)),
    edu_level = na_if(edu_level, "NA"),
    employment = na_if(employment, "NA")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    height_m = case_when(
      is.na(height_raw) ~ NA_real_,
      height_raw < 100 ~ height_raw * 0.0254,
      TRUE ~ height_raw / 100
    ),
    weight_kg = case_when(
      is.na(weight_raw) ~ NA_real_,
      weight_raw > 150 ~ weight_raw * 0.45359237,
      TRUE ~ weight_raw
    ),
    bmi = weight_kg / (height_m^2),
    bmi = if_else(is.finite(bmi) & bmi >= 10 & bmi <= 70, bmi, NA_real_),
    edu_score = case_when(
      is.na(edu_level) ~ NA_real_,
      str_detect(str_to_lower(edu_level), "no formal") ~ 1,
      str_detect(str_to_lower(edu_level), "secondary|high school|gcse") ~ 2,
      str_detect(str_to_lower(edu_level), "some college|associate") ~ 3,
      str_detect(str_to_lower(edu_level), "bachelor") ~ 4,
      str_detect(str_to_lower(edu_level), "post-graduate|postgraduate|master|phd|doctor") ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    emp_score = case_when(
      is.na(employment) ~ NA_real_,
      str_detect(str_to_lower(employment), "full-time|full time|self-employed|self employ|freelan|streamer|gig|military") ~ 4,
      str_detect(str_to_lower(employment), "part-time|part time") ~ 3,
      str_detect(str_to_lower(employment), "student") ~ 2,
      str_detect(str_to_lower(employment), "retired") ~ 2,
      str_detect(str_to_lower(employment), "homemaker|stay-at-home|disabled|unable to work|caregiver|not currently employed|unemployed|prolific") ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    SES_index = edu_score + emp_score
  ) |>
  select(pid, age, bmi, SES_index, region, gender)

# Restrict to diary participants and scale age/bmi within this subsample
# (scaling within diary sample avoids compressed covariate ranges that cause
# numerical instability in CLMM when the diary subset differs from full intake)
diary_all_pids <- unique(diary_survey$pid)
diary_covariate_lookup <- diary_covariate_lookup |>
  filter(pid %in% diary_all_pids) |>
  mutate(
    age_scaled = as.numeric(scale(age)),
    bmi_scaled = as.numeric(scale(bmi))
  ) |>
  select(pid, age_scaled, bmi_scaled, SES_index, region, gender)

# Impute missing SES_index for diary participants using MICE (PMM, m = 5)
diary_ses_n_missing <- sum(is.na(diary_covariate_lookup$SES_index))
if (diary_ses_n_missing > 0) {
  set.seed(42)
  diary_ses_imp <- mice::mice(
    diary_covariate_lookup |> select(SES_index, age_scaled, bmi_scaled, gender, region),
    m = 5, method = "pmm", maxit = 10, seed = 42, printFlag = FALSE
  )
  diary_ses_complete <- mice::complete(diary_ses_imp, 1) |>
    mutate(pid = diary_covariate_lookup$pid)
  diary_covariate_lookup <- diary_covariate_lookup |>
    select(-SES_index) |>
    left_join(diary_ses_complete |> select(pid, SES_index), by = "pid")
}

diary_covariate_lookup <- diary_covariate_lookup |>
  mutate(SES_index_scaled = as.numeric(scale(SES_index))) |>
  select(pid, age_scaled, bmi_scaled, SES_index_scaled, region, gender)

# --- Assemble diary_long ---
diary_long <- diary_survey |>
  select(
    pid, wave_id,
    day = diary_day,
    playing_last_24h = played24hr,
    sleep_quality = sleep_diary_quality,
    sleep_quality_num
  ) |>
  left_join(diary_sleep_summary, by = c("pid", "wave_id")) |>
  left_join(diary_chronotype_lookup, by = "pid") |>
  left_join(diary_covariate_lookup, by = "pid") |>
  left_join(diary_late_night, by = c("pid", "wave_id")) |>
  mutate(
    late_night_gaming_hours_24h = replace_na(late_night_gaming_hours_24h, 0),
    # Friday/Saturday = weekend (wday: 1=Sun...7=Sat)
    is_weekend = lubridate::wday(day) %in% c(6, 7)
  )

# --- Build diary_ocat with within/between decomposition ---
diary_gender_levels <- sort(unique(na.omit(diary_long$gender)))
if (length(diary_gender_levels) < 2) diary_gender_levels <- c(diary_gender_levels, "other_gender")

diary_ocat <- diary_long |>
  filter(!is.na(sleep_quality_num)) |>
  mutate(
    sleep_quality_num = pmax(pmin(as.integer(sleep_quality_num), 5L), 1L),
    late_night_minutes_trim = pmin(
      late_night_gaming_hours_24h * 60,
      quantile(late_night_gaming_hours_24h * 60, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    sleep_quality_ord = factor(
      sleep_quality_num,
      levels = 5:1,
      labels = c("Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor", "Very poor"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    is_weekend = factor(as.logical(is_weekend), levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
    gender = factor(gender, levels = diary_gender_levels)
  ) |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  mutate(
    late_night_pid_mean = mean(late_night_minutes_trim, na.rm = TRUE),
    late_night_within = late_night_minutes_trim - late_night_pid_mean
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    late_night_between = late_night_pid_mean - mean(late_night_pid_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Per-10-min scaling: effect per 10 additional minutes of late-night gaming
    ln_within_10  = late_night_within / 10,
    ln_between_10 = late_night_between / 10
  )

diary_ocat_h2 <- diary_ocat |> filter(!is.na(chronotype_centered))

diary_n_participants <- length(unique(diary_ocat$pid))
diary_n_entries <- nrow(diary_ocat)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-diary-h1-model
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| cache: false
#| eval: !expr eval_diary

library(ordinal)

# H1: Direct effects (CLMM with random intercept for participant)
# Gender is excluded: (1|gender) with only 3 levels does not converge
# Region is excluded: all diary participants are US-only (no UK participants)
# Probit link used for convergence. Late-night gaming expressed per 10 minutes.
# Positive coefficients = higher probability of worse sleep (levels=5:1 coding).
diary_h1_formula <- sleep_quality_ord ~
  ln_within_10 + ln_between_10 +
  age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + is_weekend + (1 | pid)

diary_model_h1 <- clmm(diary_h1_formula, data = diary_ocat, link = "probit", Hess = TRUE,
                        control = clmm.control(maxIter = 50000, gradTol = 0.5))
saveRDS(diary_model_h1, "output/models/diary_model_h1_sleepquality.rds")

# Spline comparison (df = 2:6) — probit CLMM with random intercept for participant
diary_covariate_terms <- c("ln_between_10", "age_scaled", "bmi_scaled",
                           "SES_index_scaled", "region", "is_weekend")

diary_spline_fits <- purrr::map(2:6, \(df) {
  f <- as.formula(paste(
    "sleep_quality_ord ~",
    paste(c(sprintf("splines::ns(ln_within_10, df = %d)", df),
            diary_covariate_terms, "(1 | pid)"), collapse = " + ")
  ))
  mod <- clmm(f, data = diary_ocat, link = "probit", Hess = TRUE,
              control = clmm.control(maxIter = 5000, gradTol = 1e-3))
  list(df = df, model = mod)
})

diary_clmm_linear <- clmm(
  sleep_quality_ord ~ ln_within_10 + ln_between_10 +
    age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + is_weekend + (1 | pid),
  data = diary_ocat, link = "probit", Hess = TRUE,
  control = clmm.control(maxIter = 5000, gradTol = 1e-3)
)

# BIC is the primary selection criterion (Jones, Nagin & Roeder 2001 rule of
# thumb on 2|ΔBIC|), aligning with the panel H1 spline sensitivity check. AIC
# is retained alongside for transparency but does not drive the df choice.
diary_spline_compare <- tibble(
  df  = purrr::map_int(diary_spline_fits, "df"),
  AIC = purrr::map_dbl(diary_spline_fits, \(x) AIC(x$model)),
  BIC = purrr::map_dbl(diary_spline_fits, \(x) BIC(x$model))
) |> arrange(BIC) |>
  mutate(deltaBIC = BIC - min(BIC),
         deltaAIC = AIC - min(AIC))

diary_linear_aic <- AIC(diary_clmm_linear)
diary_linear_bic <- BIC(diary_clmm_linear)
diary_best_spline_aic <- diary_spline_compare$AIC[1]
diary_best_spline_bic <- diary_spline_compare$BIC[1]

# Pre-compute the Jones (2001) 2|ΔBIC| verdict so the prose can reference
# definite strings (no inline ifelse/case_when in the manuscript text).
diary_spline_compare$linear_AIC <- diary_linear_aic
diary_spline_compare$linear_BIC <- diary_linear_bic

.diary_2dBIC <- 2 * abs(diary_best_spline_bic - diary_linear_bic)
.diary_favoured <- if (diary_best_spline_bic < diary_linear_bic) "spline" else "linear"
.diary_verdict <- if (.diary_2dBIC < 2) {
  "not worth mentioning"
} else if (.diary_2dBIC < 6) {
  "positive evidence"
} else if (.diary_2dBIC < 10) {
  "strong evidence"
} else {
  "very strong evidence"
}
attr(diary_spline_compare, "jones_2dBIC")   <- .diary_2dBIC
attr(diary_spline_compare, "jones_favoured") <- .diary_favoured
attr(diary_spline_compare, "jones_verdict")  <- .diary_verdict

saveRDS(diary_spline_compare, "output/models/diary_spline_compare.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-diary-h2-model
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| cache: false
#| eval: !expr eval_diary

library(ordinal)

# H2: Chronotype moderation — interaction on BOTH within and between
# Probit link for convergence. Per-10min gaming × centered chronotype interaction.
# Positive coefficients = higher probability of worse sleep (levels=5:1 coding).

# Region cannot be included in H2: all participants with chronotype data (n=509)
# are from the US, so region has only one level in diary_ocat_h2
diary_h2_formula <- sleep_quality_ord ~
  ln_within_10 * chronotype_centered +
  ln_between_10 * chronotype_centered +
  age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + is_weekend + (1 | pid)

diary_model_h2 <- clmm(
  diary_h2_formula,
  data    = diary_ocat_h2,
  link    = "probit",
  Hess    = TRUE,
  control = clmm.control(maxIter = 50000, gradTol = 0.5)
)
saveRDS(diary_model_h2, "output/models/diary_model_h2_sleepquality.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-diary-imputed-models
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| cache: false
#| eval: !expr eval_diary_imputed

# runtime: skipped entirely when params$refit_diary_imputed is false
#          (default). Expected ~10-20 min when refit_diary_imputed=true:
#          fit_on_imputations() fits 60 clmm models per hypothesis (H1 and
#          H2) on ~20k diary observations with random-intercept for pid.
#          Set -P refit_diary_imputed:true to regenerate the pooled bundles.
library(ordinal)

# Load imputed diary data (from imputation_diary.R)
diary_imputed_long_path <- "data/processed/diary_imputed_long.rds"
stopifnot(file.exists(diary_imputed_long_path))
diary_imputed_raw <- readRDS(diary_imputed_long_path)

# The imputed data has day_num (1-30) but diary models need late-night gaming
# exposure from telemetry. We join the observed late-night gaming and rebuild
# diary_ocat for each imputation.

# Prep function: builds diary_ocat-equivalent from one imputation slice
diary_imputed_prep_h1 <- function(d) {
  # Restrict to originally observed diary days only. Rows where
  # day_type_weekend_imputed_flag == TRUE are "phantom" days added during
  # grid expansion; their gaming exposure is 0 and dilutes between-person variance.
  d <- d |> filter(!day_type_weekend_imputed_flag)

  # Join late-night gaming exposure via pid + day_num → wave_id mapping
  d <- d |>
    left_join(
      diary_late_night |> rename(day_num = wave_id),
      by = c("pid", "day_num")
    ) |>
    mutate(
      late_night_gaming_hours_24h = replace_na(late_night_gaming_hours_24h, 0),
      sleep_quality_num = pmax(pmin(as.integer(sleep_diary_quality_num), 5L), 1L),
      late_night_minutes_trim = pmin(
        late_night_gaming_hours_24h * 60,
        quantile(late_night_gaming_hours_24h * 60, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      sleep_quality_ord = factor(
        sleep_quality_num,
        levels = 5:1,
        labels = c("Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor", "Very poor"),
        ordered = TRUE
      ),
      is_weekend = factor(
        day_type_weekend == 1 | day_type_dayoff == 1,
        levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)
      )
    ) |>
    group_by(pid) |>
    mutate(
      late_night_pid_mean = mean(late_night_minutes_trim, na.rm = TRUE),
      late_night_within = late_night_minutes_trim - late_night_pid_mean
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      late_night_between = late_night_pid_mean - mean(late_night_pid_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      ln_within_10  = late_night_within / 10,
      ln_between_10 = late_night_between / 10
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(sleep_quality_ord))
  d
}

diary_imputed_prep_h2 <- function(d) {
  d <- diary_imputed_prep_h1(d)
  d |> filter(!is.na(chronotype_centered))
}

# H1 formula (same as complete-case)
diary_h1_formula_imp <- sleep_quality_ord ~
  ln_within_10 + ln_between_10 +
  age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + is_weekend + (1 | pid)

# H2 formula (same as complete-case)
diary_h2_formula_imp <- sleep_quality_ord ~
  ln_within_10 * chronotype_centered +
  ln_between_10 * chronotype_centered +
  age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + is_weekend + (1 | pid)

message("Fitting diary H1 on imputed data (Rubin's rules)...")
diary_h1_rubin <- fit_on_imputations(
  diary_imputed_raw,
  prep_fn = diary_imputed_prep_h1,
  fit_fn = function(d) clmm(
    diary_h1_formula_imp, data = d, link = "probit", Hess = TRUE,
    control = clmm.control(maxIter = 50000, gradTol = 0.5)
  )
)
saveRDS(diary_h1_rubin, "output/models/imputed_diary_h1_rubin.rds")

message("Fitting diary H2 on imputed data (Rubin's rules)...")
diary_h2_rubin <- fit_on_imputations(
  diary_imputed_raw,
  prep_fn = diary_imputed_prep_h2,
  fit_fn = function(d) clmm(
    diary_h2_formula_imp, data = d, link = "probit", Hess = TRUE,
    control = clmm.control(maxIter = 50000, gradTol = 0.5)
  )
)
saveRDS(diary_h2_rubin, "output/models/imputed_diary_h2_rubin.rds")

message("Diary imputed models saved.")
```
