## Panel H1 Natural Spline Sensitivity

For each panel outcome (H1a–H1d), we replace the linear gaming predictor with a natural cubic spline (df = `r panel_h1_spline_df_range`, selected by BIC) to check whether the pre-registered linearity assumption holds. BIC is the primary criterion because its stronger complexity penalty matches the question this check is asking — whether non-linearity is warranted, not whether it yields any in-sample gain; AIC is reported alongside but does not drive df selection. BIC differences are interpreted via @jones2001nagin's rule of thumb on 2|ΔBIC|: 0–2 not worth mentioning, 2–6 positive, 6–10 strong, >10 very strong. Both linear and spline models (@tbl-appendix-panel-h1-spline-bic, @fig-appendix-panel-h1-spline-bic) are fit on the complete-case sample.

```{r}
#| label: appendix-panel-h1-spline-bic-fit
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: !expr eval_appendix

# runtime: skipped when params$refit_appendix is false (default). Expected
#          <1 min when refit_appendix=true: fits natural-spline variants of
#          each H1 model on the complete-case sample, selecting df by BIC.
#          Produces output/models/panel_h1_spline_{aic,cc_fits,ic_grid}.rds.
library(splines)
library(ordinal)

# --- Prepare complete-case datasets ---
cc_monthly_h1a_sp <- gaming_inputs[["completecase"]]$gamingMonthly |>
  enforce_monthly_wave_subset() |>
  mutate(
    psqi_comp1_quality_rounded = round(psqi_comp1_quality),
    psqi_6_ord = factor(
      psqi_comp1_quality_rounded,
      levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("Very good", "Fairly good", "Fairly bad", "Very bad"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(psqi_6_ord))

cc_monthly_sp  <- gaming_inputs[["completecase"]]$gamingMonthly |> enforce_monthly_wave_subset()
cc_biweekly_sp <- gaming_inputs[["completecase"]]$gamingBiweekly

dfs_try <- 2:6
saveRDS(dfs_try, "output/models/panel_h1_spline_dfs.rds")

h1a_sel <- run_ic_sel(cc_monthly_h1a_sp,
  function(df) make_spline_fit_fn("clmm", "psqi_6_ord",
    "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10", df), dfs_try)
h1b_sel <- run_ic_sel(cc_monthly_sp,
  function(df) make_spline_fit_fn("lmer", "total_hours_sleep",
    "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10", df, FALSE), dfs_try)
h1c_sel <- run_ic_sel(cc_monthly_sp,
  function(df) make_spline_fit_fn("lmer", "epsTotal",
    "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10", df, TRUE), dfs_try)
h1d_sel <- run_ic_sel(cc_biweekly_sp,
  function(df) make_spline_fit_fn("lmer", "wemwbs",
    "ln_biweekly_avg_minutes_played_10", df, TRUE), dfs_try)

# Linear baselines — store model objects for overlay on spline figure
cc_h1a_linear <- tryCatch(clmm(
  psqi_6_ord ~ ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10 +
    age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend + (1 | pid),
  data = cc_monthly_h1a_sp, link = "probit", Hess = TRUE,
  control = clmm.control(maxIter = 5000, gradTol = 1e-3)), error = function(e) NULL)
cc_h1b_linear <- tryCatch(lmer(
  total_hours_sleep ~ ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10 +
    age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend + (1 | pid),
  data = cc_monthly_sp, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")), error = function(e) NULL)
cc_h1c_linear <- tryCatch(lmer(
  epsTotal ~ ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10 +
    age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend +
    (1 | pid) + (1 | gender),
  data = cc_monthly_sp, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")), error = function(e) NULL)
cc_h1d_linear <- tryCatch(lmer(
  wemwbs ~ ln_biweekly_avg_minutes_played_10 +
    age_scaled + bmi_scaled + SES_index_scaled + region + isWeekend +
    (1 | pid) + (1 | gender),
  data = cc_biweekly_sp, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")), error = function(e) NULL)
.safe_ic <- function(fit, fn) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(fn(fit), error = function(e) NA_real_)
}
h1a_lin_aic <- .safe_ic(cc_h1a_linear, AIC)
h1b_lin_aic <- .safe_ic(cc_h1b_linear, AIC)
h1c_lin_aic <- .safe_ic(cc_h1c_linear, AIC)
h1d_lin_aic <- .safe_ic(cc_h1d_linear, AIC)
h1a_lin_bic <- .safe_ic(cc_h1a_linear, BIC)
h1b_lin_bic <- .safe_ic(cc_h1b_linear, BIC)
h1c_lin_bic <- .safe_ic(cc_h1c_linear, BIC)
h1d_lin_bic <- .safe_ic(cc_h1d_linear, BIC)

panel_h1_spline_aic <- tibble::tibble(
  Outcome    = c("H1a: Sleep Quality", "H1b: Sleep Duration",
                 "H1c: Daytime Sleepiness", "H1d: Wellbeing"),
  `Best df`  = c(h1a_sel$best_df, h1b_sel$best_df, h1c_sel$best_df, h1d_sel$best_df),
  `Linear AIC`  = round(c(h1a_lin_aic, h1b_lin_aic, h1c_lin_aic, h1d_lin_aic), 1),
  `Spline AIC`  = round(c(h1a_sel$best_aic, h1b_sel$best_aic,
                           h1c_sel$best_aic, h1d_sel$best_aic), 1),
  `Linear BIC`  = round(c(h1a_lin_bic, h1b_lin_bic, h1c_lin_bic, h1d_lin_bic), 1),
  `Spline BIC`  = round(c(h1a_sel$best_bic, h1b_sel$best_bic,
                           h1c_sel$best_bic, h1d_sel$best_bic), 1)
) |> dplyr::mutate(
  `ΔAIC` = round(`Spline AIC` - `Linear AIC`, 1),
  `ΔBIC` = round(`Spline BIC` - `Linear BIC`, 1),
  # Jones, Nagin & Roeder (2001) interpret 2|ΔBIC| against rule-of-thumb cuts:
  # 0-2 = "not worth mentioning"; 2-6 = "positive"; 6-10 = "strong"; >10 = "very strong".
  # The favoured model is whichever has the *lower* BIC; here we record direction
  # alongside the strength label so the table reads at a glance.
  `2|ΔBIC|` = round(2 * abs(`ΔBIC`), 1),
  Verdict = dplyr::case_when(
    `2|ΔBIC|` < 2  ~ "≈",
    `2|ΔBIC|` < 6  ~ ifelse(`ΔBIC` < 0, "+ S",   "+ L"),
    `2|ΔBIC|` < 10 ~ ifelse(`ΔBIC` < 0, "++ S",  "++ L"),
    TRUE           ~ ifelse(`ΔBIC` < 0, "+++ S", "+++ L")
  )
)

saveRDS(panel_h1_spline_aic, "output/models/panel_h1_spline_aic.rds")

# Also save the full per-df IC grid for reference / future diagnostics.
saveRDS(
  list(
    H1a = list(aics = h1a_sel$aics, bics = h1a_sel$bics),
    H1b = list(aics = h1b_sel$aics, bics = h1b_sel$bics),
    H1c = list(aics = h1c_sel$aics, bics = h1c_sel$bics),
    H1d = list(aics = h1d_sel$aics, bics = h1d_sel$bics)
  ),
  "output/models/panel_h1_spline_ic_grid.rds"
)

# --- Fit complete-case spline models (used for prediction curves) ---
cc_h1a_spline <- make_spline_fit_fn("clmm", "psqi_6_ord",
  "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10", h1a_sel$best_df)(cc_monthly_h1a_sp)
cc_h1b_spline <- make_spline_fit_fn("lmer", "total_hours_sleep",
  "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10", h1b_sel$best_df, FALSE)(cc_monthly_sp)
cc_h1c_spline <- make_spline_fit_fn("lmer", "epsTotal",
  "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10", h1c_sel$best_df, TRUE)(cc_monthly_sp)
cc_h1d_spline <- make_spline_fit_fn("lmer", "wemwbs",
  "ln_biweekly_avg_minutes_played_10", h1d_sel$best_df, TRUE)(cc_biweekly_sp)

# Bundle models + predictor x-values (needed to reconstruct ns() knots for prediction)
saveRDS(list(
  h1a = cc_h1a_spline, h1b = cc_h1b_spline,
  h1c = cc_h1c_spline, h1d = cc_h1d_spline,
  h1a_linear = cc_h1a_linear, h1b_linear = cc_h1b_linear,
  h1c_linear = cc_h1c_linear, h1d_linear = cc_h1d_linear,
  h1a_df = h1a_sel$best_df, h1b_df = h1b_sel$best_df,
  h1c_df = h1c_sel$best_df, h1d_df = h1d_sel$best_df,
  x_h1a  = cc_monthly_h1a_sp$ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10,
  x_h1b  = cc_monthly_sp$ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10,
  x_h1c  = cc_monthly_sp$ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10,
  x_h1d  = cc_biweekly_sp$ln_biweekly_avg_minutes_played_10
), "output/models/panel_h1_spline_cc_fits.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: appendix-panel-h1-spline-bic-load
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

panel_h1_spline_aic     <- tryCatch(readRDS("output/models/panel_h1_spline_aic.rds"),
                                    error = function(e) NULL)
panel_h1_spline_cc_fits <- tryCatch(readRDS("output/models/panel_h1_spline_cc_fits.rds"),
                                    error = function(e) NULL)

# Back-compat: if a legacy cached rds is loaded that lacks BIC columns, compute
# them from the stored complete-case fits. Fresh runs of appendix-panel-h1-spline-bic-fit
# populate these columns directly and this branch is a no-op.
if (!is.null(panel_h1_spline_aic) && !is.null(panel_h1_spline_cc_fits) &&
    !("Linear BIC" %in% names(panel_h1_spline_aic))) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ordinal))  # BIC dispatch for clmm
  .safe_bic <- function(fit) {
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
    tryCatch(BIC(fit), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }
  .sp <- panel_h1_spline_cc_fits
  .lin_bic <- round(c(.safe_bic(.sp$h1a_linear), .safe_bic(.sp$h1b_linear),
                      .safe_bic(.sp$h1c_linear), .safe_bic(.sp$h1d_linear)), 1)
  .spl_bic <- round(c(.safe_bic(.sp$h1a), .safe_bic(.sp$h1b),
                      .safe_bic(.sp$h1c), .safe_bic(.sp$h1d)), 1)
  panel_h1_spline_aic <- panel_h1_spline_aic |>
    dplyr::mutate(`Linear BIC` = .lin_bic,
                  `Spline BIC` = .spl_bic,
                  `ΔBIC`       = round(`Spline BIC` - `Linear BIC`, 1)) |>
    dplyr::relocate(`Linear BIC`, `Spline BIC`, .before = `ΔAIC`)
}

# Back-compat: ensure the table carries the 2|ΔBIC| column and the new
# shorthand "Verdict" column, regardless of whether the cached rds was
# written by an older fit step. Recomputes from ΔBIC when missing, and
# drops any legacy "Interpretation" column.
if (!is.null(panel_h1_spline_aic) && "ΔBIC" %in% names(panel_h1_spline_aic)) {
  if (!("2|ΔBIC|" %in% names(panel_h1_spline_aic))) {
    panel_h1_spline_aic[["2|ΔBIC|"]] <- round(2 * abs(panel_h1_spline_aic[["ΔBIC"]]), 1)
  }
  if (!("Verdict" %in% names(panel_h1_spline_aic))) {
    panel_h1_spline_aic[["Verdict"]] <- dplyr::case_when(
      panel_h1_spline_aic[["2|ΔBIC|"]] < 2  ~ "≈",
      panel_h1_spline_aic[["2|ΔBIC|"]] < 6  ~ ifelse(panel_h1_spline_aic[["ΔBIC"]] < 0, "+ S",   "+ L"),
      panel_h1_spline_aic[["2|ΔBIC|"]] < 10 ~ ifelse(panel_h1_spline_aic[["ΔBIC"]] < 0, "++ S",  "++ L"),
      TRUE                                  ~ ifelse(panel_h1_spline_aic[["ΔBIC"]] < 0, "+++ S", "+++ L")
    )
  }
  if ("Interpretation" %in% names(panel_h1_spline_aic)) {
    panel_h1_spline_aic$Interpretation <- NULL
  }
  if ("Model" %in% names(panel_h1_spline_aic)) {
    panel_h1_spline_aic$Model <- NULL
  }
}
```

## Panel: Equivalence Testing for All Confirmatory Hypotheses {#sec-appendix-equivalence}

```{r}
#| label: appendix-equivalence-thresholds
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Compute response-scale ROPE thresholds from the Rubin bundles, so the
# interpretive paragraphs below stay in sync with the actual data.
.eq_sd_y <- function(path, response) {
  b <- readRDS(path); f <- b$fits[[1]]@frame
  sd(f[[response]], na.rm = TRUE)
}
.eq_sd_prod <- function(path, a, b_) {
  b <- readRDS(path); f <- b$fits[[1]]@frame
  sd(f[[a]] * f[[b_]], na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Direct-effect response SDs (H1b–H1d, continuous)
eq_sd_sleep_h1b   <- .eq_sd_y("output/models/imputed_h1b_rubin.rds", "total_hours_sleep")
eq_sd_wemwbs_h1d  <- .eq_sd_y("output/models/imputed_h1d_rubin.rds", "wemwbs")
eq_sd_ess_h1c     <- .eq_sd_y("output/models/imputed_h1c_rubin.rds", "epsTotal")

# Half-widths on the response scale (0.1 * SD(y)) and natural-unit conversions
eq_rope_sleep_h1b_hr  <- 0.1 * eq_sd_sleep_h1b
eq_rope_sleep_h1b_min <- 60 * eq_rope_sleep_h1b_hr
eq_rope_wemwbs_h1d    <- 0.1 * eq_sd_wemwbs_h1d
eq_rope_ess_h1c       <- 0.1 * eq_sd_ess_h1c

# H2 interaction counterparts
eq_sd_sleep_h2b       <- .eq_sd_y("output/models/imputed_h2b_rubin.rds", "total_hours_sleep")
eq_sd_wemwbs_h2d      <- .eq_sd_y("output/models/imputed_h2d_rubin.rds", "wemwbs")
eq_sd_ess_h2c         <- .eq_sd_y("output/models/imputed_h2c_rubin.rds", "epsTotal")
eq_rope_sleep_h2b_min <- 60 * 0.1 * eq_sd_sleep_h2b
eq_rope_wemwbs_h2d    <- 0.1 * eq_sd_wemwbs_h2d
eq_rope_ess_h2c       <- 0.1 * eq_sd_ess_h2c

# Ordinal probit: latent-scale threshold -> cumulative-probability shift at a
# category boundary is ~ phi(0) * 0.1 = dnorm(0) * 0.1 (first-order) or
# exactly Phi(0.05) - Phi(-0.05).
eq_rope_latent     <- 0.1
eq_rope_latent_pp  <- 100 * (pnorm(0.05) - pnorm(-0.05))

# Interaction product SD (ln_minutes * msf_sc_centered), approximately equal
# across H2 bundles — take H2b as representative for prose.
eq_sd_prod_h2      <- .eq_sd_prod("output/models/imputed_h2b_rubin.rds",
                                  "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10",
                                  "msf_sc_centered")

```

We conducted frequentist equivalence tests (TOST; @lakens2017equivalence; @lakens2018equivalence) for every confirmatory hypothesis (H1a–H1d and H2a–H2d), including those that were statistically significant, by checking whether each pooled 90% CI falls inside a Region of Practical Equivalence (ROPE). Because the focal predictors are raw late-night play-time variables (per 10 min/day) rather than standardized effect sizes, Kruschke's [@kruschke2018rejecting] default ROPE of ±0.1 × SD(*y*) is rescaled to the coefficient's native units as ±0.1 × SD(*y*) / SD(*x*); for the ordinal probit models (H1a, H2a) the latent residual SD is fixed at 1 by identification, so the ROPE simplifies to ±0.1 / SD(*x*) on the latent scale, which at a category threshold corresponds to a ≈ `r fmt1(eq_rope_latent_pp)` percentage-point shift in cumulative category probability (from $\Phi(0.05) - \Phi(-0.05)$). The TOST rule accepts equivalence when the 90% CI lies entirely inside the ROPE, rejects when it lies entirely outside, and otherwise returns "Undecided". The natural-unit interpretation of the H1b–H1d response-scale half-widths (≈ ±`r fmt0(eq_rope_sleep_h1b_min)` min of sleep, ±`r fmt1(eq_rope_ess_h1c)` ESS points, and ±`r fmt1(eq_rope_wemwbs_h1d)` SWEMWBS points respectively) is given in the Discussion alongside the relevant clinical anchors. The same ±0.1 × SD(*y*) thresholds apply to the H2 interaction coefficients but now describe the change in the late-night gaming slope induced by a one-SD shift in chronotype (MSFsc); this is a stringent benchmark because the product predictor's SD (≈ `r fmt1(eq_sd_prod_h2)` for late-night minutes × MSFsc) is substantially larger than that of either factor alone.


::: {#tbl-appendix-equivalence}

```{r}
#| label: appendix-equivalence-code
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# runtime: ~seconds. Reads pooled Rubin bundles from disk and computes a
#          TOST decision manually from the pooled 90% CI against a
#          ROPE derived from the response SD. No model refitting.

library(tinytable)

et_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  # H1 direct effects
  run_tost_row("output/models/imputed_h1a_rubin.rds",
               "H1a: Sleep Quality",
               "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10",
               NULL,
               ordinal = TRUE),
  run_tost_row("output/models/imputed_h1b_rubin.rds",
               "H1b: Sleep Duration",
               "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10",
               "total_hours_sleep"),
  run_tost_row("output/models/imputed_h1c_rubin.rds",
               "H1c: Daytime Sleepiness",
               "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10",
               "epsTotal"),
  run_tost_row("output/models/imputed_h1d_rubin.rds",
               "H1d: Wellbeing",
               "ln_biweekly_avg_minutes_played_10",
               "wemwbs"),
  # H2 interactions — H2a is clmm (ordinal), the rest are lmer
  run_tost_row("output/models/imputed_h2a_rubin.rds",
               "H2a: Sleep Quality × Chronotype",
               "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10:msf_sc_centered",
               NULL,
               ordinal = TRUE),
  run_tost_row("output/models/imputed_h2b_rubin.rds",
               "H2b: Sleep Duration × Chronotype",
               "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10:msf_sc_centered",
               "total_hours_sleep"),
  run_tost_row("output/models/imputed_h2c_rubin.rds",
               "H2c: Daytime Sleepiness × Chronotype",
               "ln_monthly_avg_minutes_played_10:msf_sc_centered",
               "epsTotal"),
  run_tost_row("output/models/imputed_h2d_rubin.rds",
               "H2d: Wellbeing × Chronotype",
               "ln_biweekly_avg_minutes_played_10:msf_sc_centered",
               "wemwbs")
)

if (!is.null(et_rows) && nrow(et_rows) > 0) {
  tt(et_rows, width = 1,
     notes = c(
       "ROPE = Region of Practical Equivalence, rescaled to the native units of the raw coefficient: ±0.1 × SD(y) / SD(x) for linear mixed models and ±0.1 / SD(x) for the ordinal probit models (H1a, H2a), where the latent residual SD is fixed at 1. SD(x) is the sample SD of the focal predictor (product predictor for interactions).",
       "Decision via TOST rule (Lakens, 2017): Accepted = 90% CI entirely inside ROPE; Rejected = 90% CI entirely outside ROPE; Undecided = otherwise.",
       "p = Wald p-value for the pooled coefficient (not the TOST equivalence p)."
     )) |>
    style_tt(j = 1, align = "l") |>
    style_tt(j = 2:5, align = "r") |>
    style_tt(fontsize = 0.85)
} else {
  cat("Pooled model bundles not found. Render after the Rubin pipeline has been run.\n")
}
```

Equivalence test results for the focal predictor in every confirmatory hypothesis. H1a–H1d test the pooled late-night gaming coefficient; H2a–H2d test the pooled chronotype × late-night gaming interaction. Statistically significant effects (e.g., H1a) are included for completeness — a significant effect paired with an "Undecided" or "Rejected" equivalence decision indicates that the estimate, although reliably non-zero, is not small enough to be declared practically equivalent to the null under the ROPE.

:::
